mapper.select: SELECT st.nodeid AS nodeId, st.nodename AS nodeName, st.citycode AS cityCode, st.cityname AS cityName, st.node_address AS nodeAddress FROM station st WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM schedule sc WHERE sc.depplacename = st.nodeid OR sc.arrplacename = st.nodeid ) -- 한글을 가나다순(코드 순서)으로 정렬: DB 콜레이션(en_US 등)에 따라 순서가 달라지지 않게 고정 ORDER BY st.nodename COLLATE "C" ASC
